name: GradualBlur-TS-TW
title: Gradual Blur Overlay
blurb: Content gradually blurs and fades away at the edges, hinting there's more to…
description: An overlay that applies progressive backdrop blur and masking from one or more edges (top, bottom, left, right). Uses layered div elements with increasing blur values to create a smooth fade effect. Supports responsive sizing, scroll…
use_when: Lists or scrollable content need a visual fade-to-nothing effect that encourages scrolling and provides polish.
avoid_when: The parent container isn't positioned as relative or fixed.
a11y: Visual overlay only; doesn't affect content reachability or keyboard navigation.
